title: Unique Friend | Tencent Cloud: One-Stop Cloud Stack for AI-Native Enterprise Apps
summary: Hunyuan Turbo: Since 2023 Tencent Hunyuan pioneered MoE domestically to balance parameter scale, expert knowledge, and inference cost. Turbo moves from Hunyuan Pro’s homogeneous MoE to a new layered heterogeneous MoE — still trillion-parameter class — with +100% inference
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Insight / Unique Friend Q&A · October 11, 2024 · Guest: Tencent Cloud (腾讯云)

Hunyuan Turbo: Since 2023 Tencent Hunyuan pioneered MoE domestically to balance parameter scale, expert knowledge, and inference cost. Turbo moves from Hunyuan Pro’s homogeneous MoE to a new layered heterogeneous MoE — still trillion-parameter class — with +100% inference efficiency, −50% inference cost, +20% decode efficiency. Stronger high-quality writing, math, and logic; ships with AI-search web plugin over WeChat Official Accounts, Channels, and open web for fresher professional Q&A.

Enterprise AI build stack:

  • Infra — Tencent Cloud Intelligent Computing: heterogeneous compute, IHN high-perf network, AIGC storage, TACO AI accel kit, private intelligent-computing kit — multi-chip compatible, flexible deploy.
  • Model platform — TI: one-stop fine-tune lifecycle (data → develop → debug → publish); 20+ base models; one-click enable/deploy.
  • App layer: search augmentation + vector DB as “external hard drive” for real-time news/events and private corp data.
  • Safety — Tianyu: six-layer content safety (input → preprocess → model → policy → platform analytics → human label ops) so one integration covers the full review path.

Enterprise GenAI trends & challenges: (1) Domain RAG is the first practical path — lower hallucination, less GPU/fine-tune cost via vector DB. (2) Agents (memory, plan, tool use) will be the main landing form — either custom Agent platforms or Agent features inside existing enterprise apps. Still early-adopter stage; text hallucination, imprecise image control, video consistency limit precision/stability-hungry B scenes. OpenAI o1-style RL reasoning may help GenAI cross the chasm in enterprise services over 3–5 years.

Scenes already showing commercial value (from cloud conversations with SaaS CEOs/CTOs): AI drawing on design SaaS post-Stable Diffusion (thousands of styles; ad copy + model shoots); multimodal text-to-video for brand ads; LLM customer service with vector-domain knowledge and persona; collaborative office — Tencent Meeting AI assistant (minutes, todos, key points, reminders); Tencent Docs (instant text, formulas, tables, PPT, survey analysis, mind maps); HR/finance automation (recruit→offboard, OCR+LLM invoice capture, tax risk analytics).

— END —
